The MC structure of the Ti-6Al-4V alloy was produced by means of the multiaxial forging conducted 30-50°C below the β-transition temperature [5]. After that, the MC alloy was subjected to a heat-strengthening treatment through water quenching from 945 °С and then soaking at 500 °С for 3 hours.

Samples with the SMC structure have been prepared by means of sequential deformation of a sample along three orthogonal directions, defined as the multiaxial forging method [3]. The final temperature of the deformation was 550 °C, and a strain rate was of about 10 -3 s-1. After the multiaxial forging, the Ti-6Al-4V samples with SMC structure were annealed at 650 °С for an hour to reduce the internal stresses.

parameters.deformation: sequential deformation along three orthogonal directions

evidence.quote: Samples with the SMC structure have been prepared by means of sequential deformation of a sample along three orthogonal directions, defined as the multiaxial forging method [3]. The final temperature of the deformation was 550 °C, and a strain rate was of about 10 -3 s-1.
After the multiaxial forging, the Ti-6Al-4V samples with SMC structure were annealed at 650 °С for an hour to reduce the internal stresses.
The first stage included surface treatment by Ar+ with the energy Е=300 eV, dose D=10 19 ion/cm 2 and ion current density I=5 mA/cm 2.
At the second stage the surface was treated with N+ of Е=300 eV, D=2 ×10 19 ion/cm 2 and I=20 mA/cm 2.
After ion modification the specimens were annealed in 10 -3 MPa vacuum at 540 °С for 2 hours.
